oracle_toolchain.name: bun
oracle_toolchain.purpose: runs eslint/prettier and installs their node_modules for the root .pre-commit-config.yaml local eslint/prettier hooks and scripts/verify_precommit_manual.sh's acceptance oracle (asp-3c8)
